rules.statement: Under the law of the United States, the plaintiff does not have a maritime lien or other charge enforceable by action in rem for expenses incurred in pursuance of a statutory duty imposed by Title 46 of the Code.
rules.supporting_quote: I am satisfied that the Plaintiff has not proved that under that law a maritime lien or other charge enforceable by action in rem arises in its favour.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: United States (of America) Code, Title 46, s. 678

meta.parties: The Government of United States of America v. The Ship
